HaruNode | High-Availability Validator Infrastructure

### 🚀 Core Philosophy & Vision
HaruNode started its journey nearly two years ago with a deep passion for open-source development and blockchain infrastructure. Driven by a mindset of continuous learning and rigorous self-improvement, we work tirelessly every day to elevate our technical capabilities. Our ultimate goal is to evolve into one of the most reliable, efficient, and deeply committed ecosystem partners in the Web3 space.

### 🎯 Why gno.land?
We believe gno.land represents the next evolution of blockchain development, bringing Go directly to smart contracts via GnoVM. We aim to contribute through reliable infrastructure, developer support, and community education.

### 🛠️ Contributions
* **Infrastructure:** High-performance bare metal servers with near-zero downtime.
* **Services:** Public RPC, API, gRPC endpoints, and fast state-sync services.
* **Community:** Detailed Turkish documentation and guides for new developers.
* **Governance:** Active participation in all network proposals and ecosystem growth.

### 🔗 Digital Presence
* **GitHub:** https://github.com/logic-apex
* **X (Twitter):** https://x.com/Logic__Apex
* **Telegram:** https://t.me/harundrk

As an experienced validator operator across multiple blockchain testnets and mainnets, I look forward to contributing my operational expertise and becoming a long-term validator for the gno.land ecosystem.

For gno.land, I am committed to operating a stable validator, actively participating in testnet activities, reporting issues, sharing operational knowledge, and supporting the long-term growth of the network.

I've been interested in blockchain technology for about 7 years now. I started out as a regular user, then gradually moved to the other side - contributing and actually building.
Over the years I've taken part in testing phases for a good number of projects, helping some of them get off the ground. Along the way I've run nodes across different networks - Cosmos ecosystem chains, other L1s and L2s, Polkadot, Algorand, and more. Honestly, I've lost count of how many at this point.
Currently I'm running validators on a couple of mainnets, including Redbelly, and I'm also a validator on Safrochain mainnet.
Gno.land stands out to me - the project feels solid and the vision behind it is genuinely exciting. I'd like to contribute as much as I can, whether that's running infrastructure, testing, or just being a reliable part of the network.
Wishing the team continued success.
Twitter/X: https://x.com/zardozmonopoly

### **Validator Name**
**Kleomedes**

### **Networks Currently Validating**

    *   avi@kleomed.es
*   **Telegram Handles:** [@tsulhc](https://t.me/tsulhc), [@thebookofhealing](https://t.me/thebookofhealing)
*   **Discord Handles:** @tsulhc, @bookofhealing

---

### **Why You Are Interested in Validating on gno.land**
We are a long-time supporter of **Atom One** and are looking forward to supporting **Gno.land** because it finally democratizes access to a censorship-resistant platform. We are particularly excited about its coding architecture, which we find to be both intuitive and easy to learn.

### **Contributions to gno.land**
*   **Infrastructure:** As a primary infrastructure provider, we will support Gno.land (as we do for Atom One) by providing ancillary services such as:
    *   Enterprise-grade RPCs
    *   State sync services
    *   Snapshots
*   **Custom Dashboards:** We have extensive experience in developing custom data tools. We are available to develop similar solutions for the Gno.land ecosystem.
*   **Staking & Monitoring:** We operate [Stake-Hub.xyz](https://Stake-Hub.xyz), a user-friendly staking interface that also functions as a performance monitoring system for validator nodes and RPCs (including data points like node geo-location).

I'm from Turkey. I've been interested in testnets for a long time. And I participated in many tests. I am the first person to open a channel in the Testnet category on Youtube Turkey. Through this, I have helped many people to enter and learn in this sector. I also continue to be and teach by posting videos, guides. I am the founder and manager of Celestia and Autonomys Network projects Telegram channels in Turkey. Along with the Discord of these two projects, I am also moderating the Discord of the Dymension project and am an Ambassador at Autonomys Network. I took part in mainnet and testnets with both node setups. I joined the test network of 500+ projects and ran 1000+ nodes. In addition to my experience in testnets. I have experience in video editing, community management and moderate visual design. There are also works I have done on Youtube.
